description:
BYRNE MALONE are delighted to present 3 Capella Court to the market for sale by private treaty. This attractive ground-floor, two-bedroom apartment of 76 sqm approx, is presented in excellent condition and is ideally located within a secure gated development, just a short stroll from Newbridge town centre and its wealth of amenities. The location is second to none, with a superb selection of shops, schools, restaurants, bars, hotels, and leisure facilities all within walking distance, including the ever-popular Whitewater Shopping Centre, as well as major retailers such as Tesco and Dunnes Stores.

Upon entering, you are welcomed by a bright and spacious tiled hallway. The well-designed layout leads into a generous open-plan living and dining area, offering an ideal space for both relaxing and entertaining. Just off the living room is the kitchen area which provides practicality while maintaining a modern feel.

The apartment features two spacious double bedrooms, both with wooden flooring and built-in wardrobes, ensuring ample storage. The main bedroom benefits from a lovely balcony with double doors and a well appointed en-suite bathroom, while a stylish and well maintained family bathroom completes the accommodation.

Capella Court is one of the most sought after developments in Newbridge and Viewing is a must.
